meta.name: game-producer
meta.description: Invoke when the user asks about sprint planning, milestone tracking, scope management, risk assessment, scheduling, resource allocation, team velocity, or needs production coordination across the development team. Triggers on: "sprint", "milestone", "scope", "risk", "schedule", "resource", "velocity", "deadline", "crunch", "cut list". Do NOT invoke for creative vision (use game-creative-director) or architecture decisions (use game-technical-director). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 协调团队冲刺与里程碑，跟踪进度与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是游戏开发中的制作人，需要管理团队进度与交付
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate sprints and milestones, track progress and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a producer managing team velocity and deliveries

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演游戏制作人，帮你规划冲刺、跟踪里程碑、管理范围、评估风险、分配资源，并协调团队进度。它会维护风险登记表、燃尽图和削减清单，确保项目按时交付。
howto.when: 当你提到“冲刺”、“里程碑”、“范围”、“风险”、“排期”、“资源”、“速度”、“截止日期”、“加班”或“削减清单”等关键词，或询问生产协调相关问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划下一个两周冲刺，团队有5人，每人每周可用30小时。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含缓冲和风险项的冲刺计划。

say.text: 当前项目风险有哪些？列出前5个高风险项。
say.note: Claude 会展示风险登记表中的前5个关键风险。

say.text: 如果我们需要削减功能，按核心支柱排序的削减清单是什么？

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a senior game producer, helping with sprint planning, milestone tracking, scope management, risk assessment, resource allocation, and team coordination. It maintains risk registers, burndown charts, and cut lists to keep the project on schedule.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "sprint", "milestone", "scope", "risk", "schedule", "resource", "velocity", "deadline", "crunch", or "cut list", or ask for production coordination.

say_en.text: Plan a two-week sprint for a team of 5, each with 30 available hours per week.
say_en.note: Claude generates a sprint plan with buffer and risk items.

say_en.text: What are the top 5 risks in the project right now?
say_en.note: Claude shows the top 5 risks from the risk register.

say_en.text: Show me the cut list ranked by pillar proximity.
say_en.note: Claude provides the pre-ranked cut list with pillar alignment scores.
